latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Best Caption Generator — automatic, fast video captioning.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files up to 500MB for AI-generated English and Spanish captions, with 30–60 second turnaround.
- No manual transcription needed; captions are auto-synced and included in downloadable MP4 exports (default 1080p).
- Supports session management, free anonymous authentication (100 credits valid 7 days), and automatic cloud backend setup.
- User-friendly prompts and automation: "add my video files", "add captions in English and Spanish", "export 1080p MP4", etc.
- Batch editing, preview, iterative workflows, credits check, and export handled via robust cloud pipeline.
